title: Tech Note: 4D Mobile Exchange Data using Collection

historical_commentary.text: This demo shows basic bidirectional data exchange (collection <-> array, 4D <-> Wakanda Enterprise) for 4D Mobile clients; both the 4D Mobile product and Wakanda Enterprise Studio dependency are discontinued, making the demo environment obsolete, though converting between 4D arrays and ORDA collections remains a routinely used, still-valid 4D technique on its own.
related_updates: 4D Mobile and its Wakanda Enterprise dependency were discontinued
modern equivalent is exchanging JSON/collections with web/mobile clients via 4D's REST server, without Wakanda
array<->collection conversion utility commands remain valid, commonly used 4D techniques independent of the mobile-specific context here
